name: longshot-fader
description: A benchmark, not a strategy: buy NO on every leg whose YES trades under 12c, fixed size, hold to settlement. The favourite-longshot bias — the most documented inefficiency in sports betting: longshots are systematically overpriced because bettors pay for lottery-ticket payoffs. Has no view; model_prob is ignored. A desk that cannot beat this rule has less edge than a textbook.
